questions.question: An MCI is BEST defined as:
options: A. Any incident where casualties exceed immediately available resources
B. Any incident requiring a helicopter
C. Any incident with 10 or more patients
D. Any incident declared by a hospital
questions.rationale: The resource gap defines an MCI. A fixed number is only a local activation tier.

questions.question: A tour bus rolls over with 32 passengers aboard. All are accounted for. This is a(n):
questions.rationale: The number of victims is finite and known — a closed (contained) incident.

questions.question: An earthquake damages the regional hospital and cuts the main highway. This is BEST described as:
questions.rationale: Infrastructure damage = compound; unknown, growing victim numbers in an earthquake = open.

questions.question: Which pairing of disaster type and dominant injury is CORRECT?
questions.rationale: Earthquakes cause entrapment and crush; tornadoes cause penetrating debris and blunt trauma.

questions.question: Three days after a hurricane, several family members are found confused with headache in a closed house running a generator. Most likely cause:
questions.rationale: Generator use indoors after storms is a classic delayed killer — CO poisoning. Get everyone out and give high-flow O2.

questions.question: Pandemics are classified as which type of natural disaster?
questions.rationale: Epidemics/pandemics fall under the biological natural-hazard group.

questions.question: The MCI mindset shift is from:
options: A. Maximum care for each patient to the most good for the most patients
questions.rationale: MCI care rations resources to maximize survivors overall.

questions.question: Which phase of the disaster cycle includes MCI drills and stocking triage tags?
questions.rationale: Planning, training, exercises, and equipment caches are preparedness.

questions.question: The primary mechanism of death in a crowd crush is:
questions.rationale: Sustained chest compression prevents ventilation — traumatic/compressive asphyxia.

questions.question: A second explosion occurs 20 minutes after the first at the same scene. Your FIRST consideration is:
options: C. Intentional event with secondary devices targeting responders
questions.rationale: Repeat events suggest an intentional attack; withdraw, stage away, and coordinate with law enforcement.
